acceptance_criteria: A short tap or an interrupted hold never opens the caregiver area; only a hold of the full duration does, and the countdown is visible while holding
A profile created and activated in the caregiver area is shown on the child's board after closing, without a page reload
Concepts chosen and ordered in the caregiver area appear on the board in that order; a concept this version cannot show stays on the profile when the order is changed
When storage is unavailable the caregiver area says so in German and offers nothing that would write
User-facing text is German and the child's board shows no profile name
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: A caregiver opens the caregiver area by a deliberate press-and-hold with a visible countdown, sees the stored profiles, creates a profile, makes one active, and chooses and orders catalogue concepts for it; closing returns to the child's board, which shows the change without a reload.
non_goals: No rewording, custom concepts, export or import, delete, or repair of damaged entries (NG-13)
No change to src/profiles/, src/board-data.ts, src/startup.ts or src/app.ts behaviour
planned_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
